webpage.text:
Guardian Camera Club: Paul Gortazar's Portfolio |

A review of Paul Gortazar's Portfolio

This is a good portfolio but there are areas to be considered and improved. "At the bar" is a messy composition. "The boxing boys" again seems compositionally rather unthought out and seems to have missed the 'decisive moment' too. "Budhist Temple" is pleasant enough, the central subject certainly draws the eye, but losing the top edge of the frame would certainly strengthen the form of this image. "FOR LADIES ONLY" is again too loosely composed, moving forward would have dispensed with the avoidable periphery of this photo. The elegant "Doorway" and the dynamic "Music Band" are certainly the best two images here. This is a good portfolio, but I would recommend some careful thought on the framing of these lovely images
